name: miniswe
description: mini-swe-agent: a minimal bash-only LLM agent; works in a sandbox of the bug's buggy image (build tools + vtest, no network), may build and run the trigger test, and its edits to src/ and include/ are exported as a candidate patch per run
reference: J. Yang, C. E. Jimenez, A. Wettig, K. Lieret, S. Yao, K. Narasimhan, O. Press. SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering. NeurIPS 2024 (mini-swe-agent: the minimal successor from the same team, 2025).
